summary: Add durable client-run admission idempotence and status-before-retry reconciliation to Samantha Companion submissions.
reason: A Gateway outage before dispatch left Android in Uncertain with no server run identity, while the UI continued to show a stale completed result. The runtime could not distinguish not-submitted from lost acknowledgement.

tests.name: typescript-build
tests.evidence: npm run build passed after final runtime changes.

tests.name: submit-reconciliation
tests.evidence: Sequential and 12-way concurrent duplicate admission produced one stable run; identity conflict, persistence, by-client lookup and structured not-submitted status passed.

tests.name: conversation-regression
tests.evidence: Companion runs, conversation pages, backfill races, Capability-First and provider-fallback suites passed.

tests.name: payment-core-regression
tests.evidence: Payment Core 58/58 passed; no payment submission/replay/issuer boundary behavior changed.

tests.name: mcp-continuum-regression
tests.evidence: External MCP bridge, Continuum capability bridge and durable model-fast-path suites passed with canonical ui-playbooks root.

capabilities.reason: Capability and payment-provider truth remain in the canonical Capability Graph/payment owner. This is generic Companion request-delivery integrity.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing atomic Companion runs registry and /v1 run API; no new store, router, daemon, scheduler or retry owner.

rollback: Revert this scoped runtime commit, rebuild the existing plugin and restart only the supervised Companion. Existing rows are additive and remain readable by older code.
limitations: A transport-unavailable by-client read remains uncertain and never triggers automatic replay.
This engineering change does not execute a financial effect or weaken owner/issuer human boundaries.
